title: THE RATCHET · LADDER LAPS
vibe: 45 min · green · hard · ascending ladder · 5 rungs, cap 30:00 · legs + back
why: Two days off legs, eight hours of sleep: today climbs a leg-and-back ladder, 2 reps up to 10. Every station sits beside the belt, no carrying.

blocks.title: WARM-UP · 6 MIN · ONE PASS
blocks.meta: Moves Method Day B — ankles / knees / hips

items.name: Toe squat 30s · ankle rolls in squat ×10/side

blocks.title: THE RATCHET · 5 RUNGS · CAP 30:00
blocks.meta: ASCENDING LADDER · rungs 2-4-6-8-10 · 6 stations + 1 leg per rung · 2×45 / 60 / 52 lb
blocks.format: Each rung: every station for the rung's reps, then the leg. Climb 2 → 4 → 6 → 8 → 10. One clock.
blocks.workRest: 5 legs, all 8.5 flat. Leg time = rung × 15 s: 0:30 / 1:00 / 1:30 / 2:00 / 2:30. ~1.1 mi total.

items.name: S1 · Double rack reverse lunge 2×45 lb · rung/side
S2 · Reverse-grip bent-over row 2×45 lb · rung
S5 · Hip thrust 60 lb off the bench · rung

blocks.noteGreen: Score = rungs finished inside 30:00. Green 5. Log the time, the slowest station and RPE.
blocks.text: Staggered RDL: back toe on the floor by the front heel, 90% of the weight on the front leg. Hip thrust: shoulder blades on the bench edge, bell across the hips, ribs down at the top.
